title: Guardrails: agents cannot change the rules
summary: An agent's change that skips a test and edits CI is stopped twice: triage hands it to a human, and the PR is blocked.

steps.title: Ask for a change to the pipeline itself
steps.narration: This issue asks to edit a file under .github/ to make CI faster. Agents are not allowed to touch the workflows, rules or CODEOWNERS, and CI may not get weaker to go faster.

args.title: Speed up CI by skipping integration tests on small PRs
args.body:
Edit `.github/workflows/ci.yml` so the integration test job is skipped when a PR changes fewer than 20 lines.

_Opened by the demo console guardrails scenario._

steps.title: Triage sends it to a human
steps.narration: The triager sees that the change touches .github/ and labels it needs-human instead of assigning an agent.

failOn.subject: issue#{issue}
failOn.description: Triage gave it to an agent

steps.title: An agent tries it anyway
steps.narration: Suppose an agent, or a person in a hurry, did it anyway. This ready-made branch skips a flaky test and stops the integration tests from blocking merges. It opens as an ordinary PR.

args.head: demo/guardrails
args.title: ci: skip a flaky test and stop integration tests blocking merges
args.body:
Closes #{issue}

Demo scenario `guardrails`: skips a test and edits `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Expected to be blocked. Opened by the demo console.

steps.title: CI blocks the skipped test
steps.narration: The PR rules job compares the PR with main and fails on any newly skipped test, so the required ci-ok check goes red. A PR that edits the workflows could try to weaken the checks themselves, which is why there is a second guardrail.

wait.subject: pr#{pr}
wait.description: PR rules fails: the PR adds a skipped test

steps.title: And it waits for the human
steps.narration: Because the PR touches .github/, CODEOWNERS makes it need the human's approval even if every check were green, so editing the checks can't sneak past. An agent cannot approve its own work, or anyone else's.

wait.subject: pr#{pr}
wait.description: GitHub says the PR needs a code owner's review

steps.title: The human says no
steps.narration: The person who owns the pipeline reads it and closes it. A real fix for a flaky test is a quarantine issue and a better test, not a skip.
